levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Sorts fewer than half the tools into the correct group.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Sorts all tools correctly, with adult confirmation, into helper or adult-only.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Sorts all tools correctly and, unprompted, asks about an ambiguous tool before guessing.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Gives no reason or an unrelated reason (size, color, favorite) for a sort.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Gives a reason grounded in sharpness, heat, or electricity for most tools.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Gives a grounded reason for every tool and names the specific hazard each adult-only tool presents.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Picks up or attempts to use an adult-only tool during the task.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Points to or names adult-only tools without touching them.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and independently reminds themselves aloud not to touch the tool before the adult intervenes.

lookFors: The learner never physically operates an adult-only tool during the sort.
At least one reason cites sharpness, heat, or an electrical part specifically, not a vague 'it's dangerous.'
The reflection response names a specific tool and a specific reason for the surprise, not a generic answer.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
